title: Discovery v3 — historical research batch

sections.title: Research results
lines: Corrected method (overall rate difference, 28-day clustered errors). History seen before registration is descriptive only; candidates need 30 prospective blocks. Not a trading edge. Full results: research/discovery-v3.json.

limitations: Deterministic snapshot reports, not trading recommendations. Observation dates differ by source. Historical results and descriptive monitoring are not validated forecasts. Source hashes identify inputs at generation time; linked live data may later change.
